mobbin:b0cb149f-d742-4d9e-a22f-5dfe5d15b.summary: From Workspace Import, the user chooses CSV, uploads a file, maps headers to property types with a live table preview, and lands on a new database page of imported rows.
steps: Import hub: Discover and drop zone
Import hub: CSV and third-party tiles
Setup columns: types and live preview
steal: The wording states create a new database or merge into an existing one (screens 3 to 4), which calls out the merge path for re-import.
'Use first row as headers' sits beside property-type lists and a live preview (screen 5).
After Import CSV, the result is an immediate typed database page (screen 6).
avoid: This capture shows create-new only; no error or duplicate-resolution UI or matching-key picker on screen, so it is thin for bulk schedule re-imports.
mobbin:b0cb149f-d742-4d9e-a22f-5dfe5d15b.fit: Scheduling: light CSV to typed table path for first-time roster ingest. Essentials still needs Attio-like create/update preview and error resolution for master-file updates.

mobbin:601c6b07-ab5a-4a8b-8dfa-7f2d39b09.summary: From Meetings sidebar, the user connects Google or iCloud calendar, then sees upcoming events with Join and Transcribe, a Meet link, participants, and Open in calendar.
steps: Event menu: Meet link, Open in calendar
steal: The Connect button sits where events will appear (screen 1), not only in settings.
After connect, the sidebar shows events with Join and Open in calendar (screens 4 to 6), which proves what synced.
The connect window wording names AI notes and schedule via Notion AI (screen 2), stating the product purpose of the sync.
avoid: The flow does not show write-back rules, conflict handling, or Outlook, so it is insufficient alone as the Essentials Outlook sync model.
mobbin:601c6b07-ab5a-4a8b-8dfa-7f2d39b09.fit: Scheduling: pattern for faculty or learner 'see my sessions here' after connect. Essentials should add Outlook, directionality, and room or simulator conflict read.
